title: Lovable vs Blink: Which AI App Builder Ships Production Apps?
summary: Lovable builds beautiful frontends fast. Blink ships the full stack — database, auth, and hosting included. Here's the honest comparison to help you pick.
body_markdown: Lovable has a gentler learning curve for pure UI work — the chat interface is intuitive and the previews are immediate. But for a complete beginner who wants to end up with a working app (not just a UI),[Blink](https://blink.new/) removes more friction: there's no Supabase, Clerk, or Vercel setup to learn before the app does anything useful. Blink handles the backend automatically, so beginners can focus on what they're building instead of how infrastructure works.
